Senior Security Engineer at Echelon Risk + Cyber

Location: USA Only (Remote)
Posted: 2 days ago

Senior Security Engineer

Echelon Risk + Cyber is a cybersecurity consulting and managed security services firm. We help organizations build and mature their security programs through consulting, managed services, and incident response.

We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to join our growing team. This role involves working with clients across various industries to implement and manage security controls, conduct assessments, and respond to security incidents.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures
- Conduct security assessments (cloud, network, application)
- Implement and manage cloud security controls (Azure, AWS)
- Configure and manage CSPM, SaaS security, MDM solutions
- Run vulnerability scans and automated penetration testing
- Implement IAM/SSO/PAM solutions
- Configure and manage DLP, DR/backup solutions
- Implement CIS/NIST benchmarks
- Ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, HIPAA, PCI-DSS
- Manage SIEM platforms
- Configure and monitor MDR/IDS/IPS
- Configure and manage firewalls
- Incident response and security event analysis
- Security training and awareness programs

Requirements:
- 5+ years of security engineering experience
- CCSP, CISSP, CEH, or CISM certification preferred
- MSP/MSSP experience strongly preferred
- Strong experience with Azure and/or AWS security
- Experience with SIEM platforms (Sentinel, Splunk, etc.)
- Experience with vulnerability management and automated pentest tools
- Experience with IAM/SSO/PAM solutions
- US work authorization required (no visa sponsorship)
